title: The Dark Order's Ceremonial
description: The Dark Order's Ceremonial — The Townstons wiki
html:
The Dark Order's Ceremonial is a named mythic set in the PartialBuiltMythic / seasonal PAL templates (Mage palette).

Each piece sets SoulBound = true and a fixed base name. Rolled extra endings, if any: Mythic Suffixes.

Pieces:

  • The Dark Order's Ceremonial Robe of Extreme Vitriol — Body
  • The Dark Order's Ceremonial Shoulder Ornaments of Extreme Vitriol — Shoulders
  • The Dark Order's Ceremonial Hat of Extreme Vitriol — Helm
  • The Dark Order's Ceremonial Gloves of Extreme Vitriol — Gloves
  • The Dark Order's Ceremonial Stockings of Extreme Vitriol — Boots
